# StudentForge Events Portal

StudentForge is a campus events and ticketing platform designed for university student communities. It enables organizers to host technology workshops, student meetups, and campus gatherings with custom ticketing, secure checking, and verification flows.

- **Events Portal URL**: https://events.studentforge.in/
- **Parent Website URL**: https://www.studentforge.in/
- **Built & Powered By**: Studio Redlix (https://www.redlix.co.in/)

## Key Features & User Flows
- **Authentication**: Email verification codes (OTP) for account creation and password recovery.
- **Event Catalog**: Visual grids of upcoming and active events, searchable by title, tag, or location.
- **RSVPs & Ticketing**:
  - Free Events: Single-step, instant RSVPs.
  - Paid Events: Select ticket quantities, execute UPI scan-to-pay payments (remitted to 6302933597@hdfc), upload the 12-digit transaction ID (UTR Reference ID), and submit for host confirmation.
- **Entry Passes**: Secure entry tickets with dynamic cryptographically signed QR codes. Staff utilize the portal scanner to check in participants at physical entrances.
- **Corporate Entity**: Owned, operated, and maintained by Student Forge Technologies Private Limited, based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
